newsitem.title: CROATIA: Active Croatian stocks mostly up, Podravka in focus.
newsitem.headline: Active Croatian stocks mostly up, Podravka in focus.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly up in exceptionaly active trade on Tuesday.
* Of 12 active issues 10 were up, one down and one was flat.
* Biggest gainer was food processor Podravka, 16 kuna up to 255. It was also the most actively traded issue with 8.933 units sold.
* The only loser, cable maker Elka, edged down five kuna to 190 on volume of 55 shares.
* Volume almost trippled at 15,474 shares, turnover also up at 5.9 million kuna.
